plain_text:
Select the navigation drop-down menu to view your Data Collection Tool account information
after you have logged in (see fig. 5).

plain_text:
To see your User Name, Role, and the collection(s) to which you are assigned, select My
Account from the drop-down menu. On this page, you will also find the contact information for
the ESF Helpdesk (see fig. 6).

plain_text:
NOTE! If the information displayed in the My Account section is inaccurate, contact the
Helpdesk for assistance. Users are able to update their First and Last Name.
